title: Integrate a default-off experimental adapter
description:
Implement the approved experimental adaptation boundary for one selected backend: IPv6, unchanged SCHC compression, then experimental fragmentation/FEC. Use finalized CCP2 interfaces without repurposing legacy bits. Baseline RFC 8724 fragmentation remains required and unchanged outside the explicit experimental profile.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Affirmative microfrag.06 implementation scope is required. wire.12 and vectors.11 are coordinator-supplied finalized contracts, not broad parent dependencies. No baseline activation, radio configuration, ports or physical measurements are performed here.
acceptance_criteria: Independent encoded inputs and mixed-profile tests prove default-off behavior, unknown-profile rejection, complete framing and bounded MTU/application/output-buffer handling. Test raw fallback with at least 1281 encoded bytes for a 1280-byte IPv6 packet. Do not silently introduce double fragmentation or call this a jumbogram.
